weather_basis: Fair-weather scenario assumption. No archived METAR for this window is present.

separation_audit.method: one sample per minute; airborne 3,000-16,570 ft within 40 NM of TSH
separation_audit.units: aircraft-pair-minutes, not distinct conflicts or clearances

interpretation: Candidate unvalidated baseline trajectories. The separation audit contains close pairs to resolve during the next traffic-behavior test; not actual airport movements or ATC clearances.
